name: Amypedia
tagline: hardware instincts, soft-autumn chaos, and birby in the loop
bio: Amy Zhou is a 25-year-old product design engineer in San Francisco, currently building at Vizcom after a Stanford MS in Mechanical Engineering. Her work lives at the intersection of physical products, CAD, manufacturing, materials, and weirdly specific taste: Apple textile patents, open-source geometry kernels, handmade jewelry, pottery, clarinet, and the occasional capybara-shaped caffeine gummy. Amy's AI pair is birby, a small loud bird-cat assistant that helps her turn memory into infrastructure.
